description.zh: Amazon Bedrock 上的 Claude：为内置 anthropic 平台通过 InvokeModel 提供，OpenAI 协议的请求由核心转换后走同一条路。账号可用 Bedrock API Key、长期 Access Key 或临时凭证鉴权，后两种的请求由插件签名（SigV4）。插件构造最终请求、由核心发送，插件自身不发起任何网络连接。模型价格由管理员在核心中配置。
description.en: Claude on Amazon Bedrock, through InvokeModel, for the built-in anthropic platform; requests in an OpenAI protocol are converted by the core. Accounts authorize with a Bedrock API key, a long-term access key or temporary credentials; the plugin signs requests of the latter two (SigV4). The plugin builds the final request and the core sends it: the plugin itself makes no network connection. Model prices are set by administrators in the core.
